026        public static class ParaData {
027                public int fontSize = 0;
028                public int bulletMode = 0;
029                public Color color = Misc.getTextColor();
030                public String text;
031                public List<String> highlights = new ArrayList<>();
032                public List<Color> colors = new ArrayList<>();
033                public String image;
034                public float imageHeight;
035        }

037        public static class TextEntry extends CodexEntryV2 {
038                public List<Object> data = new ArrayList<>();
039                public String parentId;
040                public TextEntry(String id, String title, String icon) {
041                        super(id, title, icon);
042                        setParam(id);
043                }
044                
045                @Override
046                public void createTitleForList(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, ListMode mode) {
047                        super.createTitleForList(info, width, mode);
048                }
049
050                @Override
051                public boolean hasCustomDetailPanel() {
052                        return true;
053                }
054
055                @Override
056                public void createCustomDetail(CustomPanelAPI panel, UIPanelAPI relatedEntries, CodexDialogAPI codex) {
057                        Color color = Misc.getBasePlayerColor();
058                        Color dark = Misc.getDarkPlayerColor();
059                        Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
060                        Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
061                        float opad = 10f;
062                        float pad = 3f;
063                        float small = 5f;
064                        
065                        float width = panel.getPosition().getWidth();
066                        
067                        float initPad = 0f;
068                        
069                        float horzBoxPad = 30f;
070                        
071                        // the right width for a tooltip wrapped in a box to fit next to relatedEntries
072                        // 290 is the width of the related entries widget, but it may be null
073                        float tw = width - 290f - opad - horzBoxPad + 10f;
074                        
075                        TooltipMakerAPI text = panel.createUIElement(tw, 0, false);
076                        text.setParaSmallInsignia();
077                
078                        int prevBulletMode = 0;
079                        for (Object o : data) {
080                                if (o instanceof ParaData) {
081                                        ParaData para = (ParaData) o;
082                                        
083                                        TooltipMakerAPI curr = text;
084                                        float outerPad = initPad;
085                                        if (para.image != null) { 
086                                                float height = para.imageHeight;
087                                                if (height <= 0f) height = Global.getSettings().getSprite(para.image).getHeight();
088                                                curr = text.beginImageWithText(para.image, height);
089                                                initPad = 0f;
090                                        }
091                                        
092                                        if (prevBulletMode != 0 && para.bulletMode != 0) { 
093                                                initPad = 0f;
094                                        }
095                                        prevBulletMode = para.bulletMode;
096                                        
097                                        if (para.fontSize == -1) {
098                                                curr.setParaFontDefault();
099                                        } else if (para.fontSize == 0) {
100                                                curr.setParaSmallInsignia();
101                                        } else if (para.fontSize == 1) {
102                                                curr.setParaSmallOrbitron();
103                                        } else if (para.fontSize == 2) {
104                                                curr.setParaOrbitronLarge();
105                                        } else if (para.fontSize == 3) {
106                                                curr.setParaOrbitronVeryLarge();
107                                        }
108                                        
109                                        if (para.bulletMode == 0) {
110                                                curr.setBulletedListMode(null);
111                                        } else if (para.bulletMode == 1) {
112                                                curr.setBulletedListMode(BaseIntelPlugin.INDENT);
113                                        } else if (para.bulletMode == 2) {
114                                                curr.setBulletedListMode(BaseIntelPlugin.BULLET);
115                                        }
116                                        
117                                        LabelAPI label = curr.addPara(para.text, initPad, 
118                                                        para.colors.toArray(new Color[0]), para.highlights.toArray(new String[0]));
119                                        label.setColor(para.color);
120                                        label.setHighlight(para.highlights.toArray(new String[0]));
121                                        label.setHighlightColors(para.colors.toArray(new Color[0]));
122                                        initPad = opad;
123                                        
124                                        prevBulletMode = para.bulletMode;
125                                        
126                                        if (para.image != null) { 
127                                                text.addImageWithText(outerPad);
128                                        }
129                                        
130                                        if (para.fontSize > 0) {
131                                                text.addSpacer(-opad + pad);
132                                        }
133                                }
134                        }
135                        panel.updateUIElementSizeAndMakeItProcessInput(text);
136                        
137                        UIPanelAPI box = panel.wrapTooltipWithBox(text);
138                        panel.addComponent(box).inTL(0f, 0f);
139                        if (relatedEntries != null) {
140                                panel.addComponent(relatedEntries).inTR(0f, 0f);
141                        }
142                        
143                        float height = box.getPosition().getHeight();
144                        if (relatedEntries != null) {
145                                height = Math.max(height, relatedEntries.getPosition().getHeight());
146                        }
147                        panel.getPosition().setSize(width, height);
148                }
149        }

152        public static ListMap<String> LINKS = new ListMap<>();
153        public static void linkRelated() {
154                for (String key : LINKS.keySet()) {
155                        CodexEntryPlugin entry = CodexDataV2.getEntry(key);
156                        for (String key2 : LINKS.getList(key)) {
157                                CodexEntryPlugin other = CodexDataV2.getEntry(key2);
158                                if (entry != null && other != null) {
159                                        CodexDataV2.makeRelated(entry, other);
160                                }
161                        }
162                }
163                LINKS.clear();
164        }
165        
166        public static void loadTextEntries() {
167                try {
168                        String csvName = "data/codex/text_codex_entries.csv";
169                        Global.getLogger(CodexTextEntryLoader.class).info("Loading [" + csvName + "]");
170                        //JSONArray rows = Global.getSettings().loadCSV(csvName, true);
171                        JSONArray rows = Global.getSettings().getMergedSpreadsheetData("filename", csvName);
172                        
173                        for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
174                                JSONObject row = rows.getJSONObject(i);
175                                String filename = row.getString("filename");
176                                Global.getLogger(CodexTextEntryLoader.class).info("Loading [" + filename + "]");
177                                String contents = Global.getSettings().loadText(filename);
178                                Global.getLogger(CodexTextEntryLoader.class).info("Parsing [" + filename + "]");
179                                parseContents(contents, filename);
180                        }
181                } catch (IOException e) {
182                        throw new RuntimeException(e);
183                } catch (JSONException e) {
184                        throw new RuntimeException(e);
185                }
186        }
187        
188        
189        public static void parseContents(String contents, String filename) {
190                contents = contents.replaceAll("\\r", "").trim();
191                String [] lines = contents.split("\\n");
192
193                Color base = Misc.getBasePlayerColor();
194                Color dark = Misc.getDarkPlayerColor();
195                
196                Color currColor = null;
197                int currFontSize = 0;
198                String currCategory = null;
199                String paraImage = null;
200                int paraImageHeight = 0;
201                
202                TextEntry entry = null;
203                int lineNum = 0;
204                for (String line : lines) {
205                        lineNum++;
206                        if (line.startsWith("#")) continue;
207                        if (line.isBlank()) continue;
208                        line = line.trim();
209                        
210                        if (line.startsWith("CATEGORY ")) {
211                                line = line.replaceFirst("CATEGORY ", "").trim();
212                                Global.getLogger(CodexTextEntryLoader.class).info("Parsing category [" + line + "]");
213                                String [] arr = line.split("\\|");
214                                TextEntry cat = new TextEntry(arr[0], arr[2], CodexDataV2.getIcon(arr[1]));
215                                cat.parentId = arr[3];
216                                cat.setParam(null);
217                                CodexDataV2.ENTRIES.put(cat.getId(), cat);
218                                CodexEntryPlugin parent = CodexDataV2.getEntry(cat.parentId);
219                                if (parent != null) {
220                                        cat.setParent(parent);
221                                        parent.addChild(cat);
222                                }
223                                continue;
224                        }
225                        
226                        if (line.startsWith("COLOR ")) {
227                                line = line.replaceFirst("COLOR ", "").trim();
228                                currColor = getColor(line);
229                                continue;
230                        }
231                        if (line.startsWith("FONT ")) {
232                                line = line.replaceFirst("FONT ", "").trim();
233                                currFontSize = line.toLowerCase().equals("small") ? -1 : 0;
234                                continue;
235                        }
236                        if (line.startsWith("IMAGE ")) {
237                                line = line.replaceFirst("IMAGE ", "").trim();
238                                String [] arr = line.split("\\|");
239                                paraImage = arr[0];
240                                if (arr.length > 1) {
241                                        try {
242                                                paraImageHeight = Integer.parseInt(arr[1]);
243                                        } catch (Throwable t) {
244                                                paraImage = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName(arr[0], arr[1]);
245                                                if (arr.length > 2) {
246                                                        paraImageHeight = Integer.parseInt(arr[2]);
247                                                }
248                                        }
249                                } else {
250                                        paraImageHeight = 0;
251                                }
252                                continue;
253                        }
254                        if (line.startsWith("RESET")) {
255                                currColor = getColor("text");
256                                currFontSize = 0;
257                                continue;
258                        }
259                        if (line.startsWith("CURRENT_CATEGORY ")) {
260                                line = line.replaceFirst("CURRENT_CATEGORY ", "").trim();
261                                currCategory = line;
262                                continue;
263                        }
264                        
265                        if (line.startsWith("BEGIN ")) {
266                                line = line.replaceFirst("BEGIN ", "").trim();
267                                Global.getLogger(CodexTextEntryLoader.class).info("Parsing entry [" + line + "]");
268                                String [] arr = line.split("\\|");
269                                entry = new TextEntry(arr[0], arr[1], null);
270                                entry.parentId = currCategory;
271                                if (arr.length >= 3) entry.parentId = arr[2];
272                                continue;
273                        }
274                        
275                        if (entry == null) {
276                                throw new RuntimeException(String.format("Error parsing [%s] line %s, expected to be inside entry",
277                                                filename, "" + lineNum));
278                        }
279                        
280                        if (line.startsWith("END")) {
281                                if (entry.getIcon() == null) {
282                                        String icon = CodexDataV2.getIcon("generic");
283                                        entry.setIcon(icon);
284                                }
285                                CodexEntryPlugin parent = CodexDataV2.getEntry(entry.parentId);
286                                if (parent != null) {
287                                        entry.setParent(parent);
288                                        parent.addChild(entry);
289                                }
290                                entry = null;
291                                currColor = null;
292                                currFontSize = 0;
293                                continue;
294                        }
295                        
296                        if (line.startsWith("ICON ")) {
297                                line = line.replaceFirst("ICON ", "").trim();
298                                String icon = CodexDataV2.getIcon(line);
299                                entry.setIcon(icon);
300                                continue;
301                        }
302                        
303                        if (line.startsWith("RELATED ")) {
304                                line = line.replaceFirst("RELATED ", "").trim();
305                                String [] ids = line.split("\\|");
306                                for (String id : ids) {
307                                        //entry.addRelatedEntry(id);
308                                        LINKS.add(entry.getId(), id);
309                                }
310                                continue;
311                        }
312                        
313                        
314                        ParaData para = new ParaData();
315                        
316                        Pattern p = Pattern.compile("(?is)^(=+)(.+?)=+$");
317                    Matcher m = p.matcher(line);
318                    if (m.find()) {
319                        line = m.group(2);
320                        para.fontSize = m.group(1).length();
321                        para.color = base;
322                    }
323                    
324                    if (line.startsWith("_ ")) {
325                        line = line.replaceFirst("_ ", "").trim();
326                        para.bulletMode = 1;
327                    } else if (line.startsWith("- ")) {
328                        line = line.replaceFirst("- ", "").trim();
329                        para.bulletMode = 2;
330                    }
331                    
332                    p = Pattern.compile("(?is)\\{\\{(.*?)\\}\\}");
333                    m = p.matcher(line);
334                    
335                    while (m.find()) {
336                        String curr = m.group(1);
337                        String replacement = "";
338                        if (curr.startsWith("color:")) {
339                                curr = curr.replaceFirst("color:", "").trim();
340                                String [] arr = curr.split("\\|");
341                                Color color = getColor(arr[0]);
342                                para.colors.add(color);
343                                para.highlights.add(arr[1]);
344                                replacement = arr[1];
345                        } else if (curr.startsWith("rel:")) {
346                                curr = curr.replaceFirst("rel:", "").trim();
347                                String [] arr = curr.split("\\|");
348                                //entry.addRelatedEntry(arr[0]);
349                                LINKS.add(entry.getId(), arr[0]);
350                                para.colors.add(base);
351                                para.highlights.add(arr[1]);
352                                replacement = arr[1];
353                        } else {
354                                Color color = Misc.getHighlightColor();
355                                para.colors.add(color);
356                                para.highlights.add(curr);
357                                replacement = curr;
358                        }
359                        line = line.replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(m.group(0)), replacement);
360                    }
361                    
362                    para.text = line.replaceAll("%", "%%");
363                    if (currColor != null) {
364                        para.color = currColor;
365                    }
366                    if (para.fontSize == 0) {
367                        para.fontSize = currFontSize;
368                    }
369                    
370                    para.image = paraImage;
371                    para.imageHeight = paraImageHeight;
372                    paraImage = null;
373                    paraImageHeight = 0;
374                    
375                    entry.data.add(para);
376                }
377                
378                if (entry != null) {
379                        throw new RuntimeException(String.format("Error parsing [%s] file ended while still parsing entry", filename));
380                }
381        }
382        
383        public static Color getColor(String str) {
384                if (Global.getSettings().hasDesignTypeColor(str)) {
385                        return Global.getSettings().getDesignTypeColor(str);
386                }
387                
388                Color dark = Misc.getDarkPlayerColor();
389                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
390                Color bad = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
391                Color good = Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor();
392                Color gray = Misc.getGrayColor();
393                Color textColor = Misc.getTextColor();
394                Color player = Misc.getBasePlayerColor();
395                
396                Color color = null;
397                if (str.equals("h")) color = h;
398                else if (str.equals("good")) color = good;
399                else if (str.equals("bad")) color = bad;
400                else if (str.equals("gray")) color = gray;
401                else if (str.equals("grey")) color = gray;
402                else if (str.equals("text")) color = textColor;
403                else if (str.equals("player")) color = player;
404                else if (str.equals("blue")) color = player;
405                else if (str.equals("base")) color = player;
406                else if (str.equals("dark")) color = dark;
407                else color = Global.getSettings().getColor(str);
408                if (color == null) {
409                        throw new RuntimeException(String.format("Parsing error: color [%s] not found", str));
410                }
411                return color;
412        }
